hazards.name: Isolation and Confinement
hazards.detail: Behavioral responses in small groups over long periods.

hazards.name: Distance from Earth
hazards.detail: Resupply, supplies and medical care get harder to receive as distance grows.

hazards.name: Gravity Fields
hazards.detail: Muscles, bones, inner ear and organs adapt to changing gravity.

hazards.name: Hostile / Closed Environments
hazards.detail: Temperature, pressure, lighting, noise, microbes and immune responses.

hazard_facts.fact: Mars is on average 140 million miles from Earth.
A Mars trip would take roughly three years, versus a three-day lunar trip.
On Mars, astronauts would live in three-eighths of Earth's gravity for up to two years.

neutron_radiation.finding: Neutron radiation contributes about 30% of total radiation on the ISS and is described as especially harmful because it can cause serious biological damage.
